title: Chapter 2933 - 170: Killing Machine
content:
Chapter 2933: Chapter 170: Killing Machine

Lugu’s corpse clawed out the Golden Core of the Gao Tu Tribe’s Barbarian General, and then... swallowed it whole.

The Golden Core, intertwined with Blood Qi and Spiritual Power through cultivation, was forcibly chewed to pieces.

The powerful force contained within it exploded, distorting Lugu’s face and entire skull, yet it could not avoid the fate of being chewed and devoured.

Lugu, with his face bloody and flesh obscured, consumed the Golden Core of the Gao Tu Tribe’s Barbarian General as if it were a "fruit."

This scene was incredibly horrifying.

All the Barbarian Generals in the Golden Core Realm felt their painstakingly nurtured Golden Core in their Dantians tremble, emitting a cold chill.

In their lifetime, they had never witnessed such a bizarre event.

Even Demon Cultivators haven’t done such a thing.

What’s more bizarre is that after Lugu’s corpse consumed the Golden Core, ancient and ferocious Beast Patterns emerged on his body.

These Beast Patterns seemed to come "alive," absorbing the Golden Core Spiritual Power, and then feeding this Spiritual Power back to Lugu’s remains.

These ferocious Beast Patterns almost appeared as a "totem" on Lugu’s body.

And Lugu seemed merely a "medium" for these Beast Patterns.

Lugu is a person, the Beast Patterns are the formation.

But the Beast Patterns were alive, while Lugu was dead.

This eerie and chaotic feeling shrouded everyone’s heart.

Meanwhile, Lugu, whose aura was weak and Spiritual Power depleted, seemed replenished with Golden Core Power, emitting a deep and cold blue light as his aura surged instantaneously.

It was as if he had recharged and "come back to life."

"Be careful!" Gao Du shouted fiercely.

Another Barbarian General from the Gao Tu Tribe, suppressing Lugu, panicked, hearing the warning and tried to flee, but it was too late.

Lugu’s bloody hand had already gripped his neck, twisting it forcefully until it was deformed.

This Barbarian General practiced the Hundred Vipers Skill, but lacked proficiency, unable to separate bones and flesh to "Escape like a Snake" as Gao Du did, and once grabbed by Lugu, he couldn’t break free.

In the next moment, he met a tragic fate.

His abdomen was pierced by Lugu, and the Golden Core within his Dantian was also clawed out by Lugu’s large hand, like a monster, and swallowed.

The Taotie Pattern on Lugu’s body shone ever brighter, even carrying a hint of wickedness, like a giant beast inhaling and exhaling.

Two consecutive tribes’ Barbarian Generals, both trusted followers, brutally slaughtered by Lugu, filled Gao Du, being a General himself, with immediate rage.

Disregarding fright, he gritted his teeth and forcibly activated the Hundred Vipers Skill, his hands like snakes, bone blades infused with poison, charged at Lugu once more.

But this pair of sinister and fearsome bone blades was gripped firmly by Lugu’s large hand.

Lugu had consecutively slain two Barbarian Generals and swallowed two Golden Cores, receiving ample Spiritual Power replenishment, his Strength extraordinarily powerful.

Gao Du, after continuous battles, found his strength waning and suddenly felt immense pressure.

What frightened him even more was that Lugu, holding his bone blade with his left hand, reached for his abdomen with his right hand.

The intention was clearly to seize his Golden Core.

Gao Du’s heart chilled, immediately breaking free and retreating, as Lugu growled, pursuing him like a "monster."

Gao Du fought back and retreated.

In the Gu poison swamp, the area permeated with fierce poison, it was Gao Du’s own battlefield.

Yet he was being pressed and pursued by Lugu, who was already a corpse and "immune to all poisons," fighting back overwhelmed.

The situation looked dire.

An elderly Elder from the Gao Tu Tribe, upon seeing this scene, remarked solemnly, "Deploy the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net to intercept this monster!"

In the poison swamp, water ripples shook, poison vines suddenly spread, forming a net like chains, tightly trapping "Lugu."

The net woven from poison vines envenomed and with numerous Gu Worms parasitizing within them.

Raising these Gu Worms and refining this poison net takes over a hundred years.

This is the Gao Tu Tribe’s most venomous trap and the deadliest method.

Originally used for, at critical moments, trapping and killing enemy leaders, such as Generals like Lugu or a "Divine Blessing" like Mo Hua.

Now Gao Du, hunted by Lugu, was forced to deploy the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net to suppress Lugu.

But the problem is, Lugu is not a living person. He is a corpse.

Gu Worms do not harm him, nor do thousands of toxins corrode him. Because his flesh was initially "dead."

Gu is useless, poison is useless.

This Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net is equivalent to being largely nullified, retaining only the function of "trapping the enemy."

It cannot kill, only trap.

Even just using the poison net to trap him is insufficient.

A group of Gao Tu Barbarian Generals, along with numerous Barbarian Soldiers, could only form an array and rely on the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net to take turns suppressing Lugu.

Under the joint effort of the Barbarian Soldiers, relying on the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net, Lugu was finally suppressed.

Hence, General Gao Du gained a moment of respite.

Gao Du wasted no time, immediately swallowing some Pills, eating chunks of meat from unknown poisonous beasts, and sat down to recover his strength.

When his strength was more than half recovered, Gao Du opened his eyes, discovering that over such time, the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net was starting to struggle in suppressing Lugu’s corpse.

Gao Du was shocked, had no choice but to personally combat and battle Lugu.

With him as the General, directly facing Lugu’s pressure, other Barbarian Generals and Barbarian Soldiers joined forces, and utilizing the Hundred Gu Thousand Poison Net, they finally subdued Lugu once more.

Lugu’s corpse, similar to before, began to dim its blue light gradually, and its movements slowly became sluggish.
